Honest comparison

We'll be honest — Tally has real advantages

This isn't a one-sided comparison. Here's exactly what each tool does better.

Where Tally wins

  • Unlimited free responses (no monthly cap)
  • No Tally branding on free plan
  • Notion-like block editor — very fast to build
  • Larger free storage for file uploads
  • Loved by the indie/maker community

Where FormflowX wins

  • Drop-off analytics — per-question abandonment rates
  • Partial submission capture — recover incomplete leads
  • AI form builder on all plans including free
  • More integrations: Notion, Slack, Webhooks, Zapier
  • Custom domain at $15/mo (Tally: $29/mo)
  • Remove branding at $15/mo (Tally: $29/mo)
📉

You can't fix what you can't see

Tally tells you how many responses you got. It doesn't tell you that 70% of people dropped off at question 4. FormflowX does — so you can rewrite that question and recover those leads.

📬

Incomplete ≠ lost

When someone fills in their email and then closes the tab without finishing, Tally records nothing. FormflowX Pro captures their partial response — turning an abandoned form into a recoverable lead.

🤖

AI that actually builds the form

FormflowX's AI builder takes a one-sentence prompt and generates a complete form — questions, options, logic branches — ready to publish. Tally's AI features are more limited and less integrated.

FAQ

Common questions

Should I use Tally or FormflowX?

If you want unlimited free responses and no branding restrictions on the free plan, Tally is genuinely hard to beat. If you care about knowing where people abandon your forms, recovering partial leads, or having an AI builder generate forms for you, FormflowX is the better fit. Most teams switch to FormflowX when they start treating forms as a conversion funnel rather than a simple data collection tool.

Does Tally have drop-off analytics?

No. As of July 2026, Tally does not offer per-question drop-off tracking. You can see total response counts, but not which specific question causes abandonment. FormflowX Pro includes full drop-off analytics showing the abandonment rate at every question in your form.

Is FormflowX more expensive than Tally?

For paid plans, FormflowX is cheaper: Pro is $15/mo vs Tally's $29/mo. Tally's free plan is more generous (unlimited responses vs FormflowX's 100/mo). So Tally costs less if you stay free, but FormflowX costs less once you need paid features.

Can I switch from Tally to FormflowX?

Yes. You can recreate your forms quickly in FormflowX — the AI builder can generate a similar form from a brief description in seconds. For complex logic trees, you can rebuild them using the visual logic editor. Most forms take under 10 minutes to migrate.

Does FormflowX have the same block editor as Tally?

FormflowX uses a different builder — a structured question-by-question editor optimised for conversational forms rather than Tally's Notion-style blocks. If you're used to the Notion block paradigm, there's a small learning curve, but most people find FormflowX's editor faster for building standard forms.
